data.industry_identification:
TARC Limited derives its revenue from the development and sale of residential and commercial real estate projects in the National Capital Region (Delhi/Gurugram) — e.g. TARC Ishva, TARC Kailasa, TARC Tripundra, TARC Maceo — together with rental income from investment properties. Since the primary operating segment (sale of constructed residential/commercial property) contributes materially more than 50% of consolidated revenue, the issuer is classified under the NSE Basic Industry 'Residential, Commercial Projects' (exact_code: IN020501001) within Sector 'Realty' / Macro Economic Sector 'Consumer Discretionary'.

The similar code 'Real Estate related services' (INO20501002) was considered because TARC also earns incidental rental/lease income from investment properties, but this was not selected as the exact classification because leasing/services income is not the dominant revenue driver — construction and sale of developed property is.
